purpose: Static-call whitelist for the Godot built-in classes A7 audits. A static call is the only legal way to invoke a static method; a name that is absent here cannot be called as Type.name(...) at all.

provenance.source: Godot engine doc/classes/*.xml on the upstream master branch, fetched 2026-10-30
provenance.note: Only audited classes are listed. A type absent from this map is not checked, so the audit never claims more than it read.
